request: Reaction videos must be uploads. The buyer chooses one version to send and keeps all versions. The gift page should show a 3D spinning record, an occasion background, and an optional uploaded image.

requirements.acceptance: Only the chosen version appears and can be fetched with the gift key.
A dimensional record spins on play, stops on pause, and respects reduced motion.
Birthday, anniversary, wedding, reconnection, and just-because have distinct treatments. Optional uploaded photo appears as sleeve art.
Buyer chooses one version before sharing and retains every original and revision.
Files upload with consent, progress and retry. Photos up to 8 MB and reaction videos up to 50 MB.
Owner can view and download uploaded videos; gift recipient cannot fetch them.
